summary: Refactored Proposal and ConsensusManager with: (1) Added `__slots__` for memory optimization, (2) Comprehensive input validation for all public methods, (3) Type hints and `Final` constants for clarity, (4) `__repr__` methods for debugging, (5) Stripped whitespace from string inputs, (6) Removed redundant `Final` for mutable attributes, (7) Added validation to `ConsensusManager.process_signature` for proposal type.
